papers.title: Social cognition and executive functions in parents of children with autism: a case-control study using an affective stroop fMRI paradigm.
papers.reason: This human fMRI case-control study uses Stroop interference and executive-function measures to identify altered anterior cingulate and medial frontal activation during emotion-related cognitive control.

papers.title: Effect of a Virtual Reality Cognitive Psychological Intervention on Depression, Sleep, and Cognition in Adolescent Patients With Depression: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
papers.reason: The title indicates a clinical intervention study measuring cognition broadly in adolescent depression, but provides no clear link to executive-function modelling, neural mechanisms, or multimodal cognitive assessment.

papers.title: A Common Recognition Architecture Across Memory Scales
papers.reason: Human EEG evidence that recognition memory across working-memory to long-term-memory scales uses a shared neural format could inform computational models of memory and executive function.
